notes.title: Get The Gems RELOADED released!
notes.content:
Finally, the time has come!

I am happy to announce that I have just released a completely revised and improved version of Get The Gems.

Get The Gems RELOADED has been reprogrammed from scratch in an up-to-date language and improved in every way. Among other things, I have of course taken your great feedback into account. Please continue to use the game’s Community Hub on Steam.

Here is an overview of the new features:


[b]Core Engine[/b]
[list][*]Rewritten from scratch in an up-to-date language
[*]OpenGL and Vulkan support
[*]The player’s desktop resolution is used ingame
[*]Tiles are always square, regardless of the resolution
[*]Latest Microsoft Windows supported[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Campaign Mode and Practice Mode
[*]Player progress autosave
[*]Unlimited lives
[*]Enhanced player controls
[*]Time limit can be deactivated in Practice Mode
[*]Cam is now centered on player
[*]Enhanced monster pathfinding
[*]Improved ingame UI[/list]

[b]Caves[/b]
[list][*]Many caves have been replaced
[*]Most caves have been reworked
[*]Unlocked caves can be played again at any time
[*]Improved cave entering[/list]

[b]GFX[/b]
[list][*]Many sprites have been reworked or replaced
[*]Added animation for soil eating
[*]Improved explosion animation
[*]Gems now sparkle randomly
[*]Added player death and cave success animation[/list]

[b]SFX[/b]
[list][*]Awesome menu music track
[*]Major sound revision
[*]Many new sounds added
[*]Random creepy sounds during gameplay[/list]

[b]MISC[/b]
[list][*]Achievements updated
[*]New game menu
[*]More rewarding score system
[*]Enhanced player statistics
[*]Gameplay recording issues eliminated
[*]Improved help
[*]Added tips to main menu
[*]LOTS OF OTHER FEATURES[/list]

[b]HAPPY SPELUNKING !
PSY[/b]

notes.title: Recommended Settings
notes.content:
Greetings Cave Dwellers,


to ensure the best gameplay experience possible, please use the following game options:


[h1] VSYNC [/h1]
Set to OFF (default), unless your monitor runs @100Hz+ !
The game runs best @100fps.
Most monitors run @60Hz, so if you enable VSYNC, the game will run @60fps, which will ruin the gameplay.


[h1] GAMESPEED [/h1]
Set to the 5th position from the left, which equals 100fps (default) !
There are 8 different gamespeed settings, but only positions 5, 6, 7 and 8 are recommended.


[h1] GIMP ENEMIES [/h1]
Set to OFF (default) !
With this setting, the crabs and worms will use a more clever pathfinding algorithm, which will result in less enemies going crazy when there is no soil around them.


[h1] SOUND / MUSIC / SCREENSHAKE [/h1]
For your convenience ːsteamhappyː


Have fun,
PSY

notes.title: Character movement improved / fixed
notes.content:
Greetings Cave Dwellers,

There has been another small patch which fixes the character movement.

Depending on the framerate and the exact moment the [CTRL] key and one or more movement keys were pressed simultaneously, it was possible the character moved AFTER releasing the [CTRL] key.

This has been fixed.
Thank you W.A. the Anum for reporting this bug!


Enjoy and have fun,

PSY-LABS

notes.title: Time extension for Cave 7 and 8
notes.content:
Greetings Cave Dwellers,

There has been another small patch which extends the time for Cave 7 ( +60 seconds ) and Cave 8 ( +50 seconds ).

Even if played well, there was almost no time left when exiting the Caves, rendering the bonus time reward insignificant.


PSY-LABS

notes.title: New resizable window mode
notes.content:
Hi all,

some players encountered a problem when running Get The Gems in Exclusive Fullscreen mode.
The problem only occurred in certain combinations, depending on the operating system, the GFX card and the DX version.

There are now 3 options when you launch the game via your STEAM library:

1:  Play Get The Gems
2:  Play Get The Gems (Fullscreen Mode)
3:  Play Get The Gems (Window Mode - Resizable)

Please use mode 3 if the Exclusive Fullscreen Mode doesn't work for you.
You can resize your window to any desired size in this mode.


Enjoy,
PSY-LABS

notes.title: Launch Options updated
notes.content:
Just fixed the launch option description.

There are 2 modes now:

- Play Get The Gems
- Play Get The Gems (Window Mode)

To be able to choose between the different modes, press the PLAY button in your STEAM library!

Launching the game via desktop shortcut will automatically enable Fullscreen Mode. 


Have fun :D
